policy.extent: Every square is 5 miles across, centred on the route and summit together, so peaks compare at one scale. Wireframes show the circle inscribed in it
policy.spikes: A cell more than 300 m from the median of its 5-by-5 neighbourhood is corrupt source data and takes that median
policy.route: Cheapest way along OpenStreetMap paths to the node nearest the summit, from the connected node nearest the trailhead. Trails named in the peak's `prefer` list cost their length; other trails cost four times as much and alpine scrambles three times more again, so the named route is followed where it exists. A loop continues through its `via` points and back to the start, with ground already walked costing twelve times as much
